title: fitXI
one_liner: An offline-first player load and wellness monitoring PWA for football clubs in Zimbabwe and southern Africa.
problem: Many clubs lack affordable tools to consistently track training load and player wellness.
approach: Combines session RPE and daily wellness check-ins with offline logging, background sync, dashboards, and transparent traffic-light indicators.
highlights: Designed for offline use on affordable Android devices
Tracks session RPE, training load, sleep, soreness, and mood
Uses transparent rule-based load and wellness indicators
Supports background synchronization after connectivity returns
Includes CSV export for clubs and federations
Designed with consent, club isolation, and minimal data collection

title: Mbonge Redeem Portfolio
one_liner: A personal portfolio built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide icons that showcases backend engineering projects and links to their source code.
problem: Communicating technical expertise and project portfolio to potential employers and collaborators.
approach: Employs a server‑rendered Next.js site with typed React components, Tailwind styling, and integrated icons to present project summaries and direct links to public GitHub repositories.
highlights: Next.js 14 App Router for optimal routing
Tailwind CSS with animate plugin for responsive UI
Lucide React icons for clear visual cues
TypeScript for type safety across components
ESLint and PostCSS configured for code quality
